answer: Each agent identity is a pearl grown in layers: every verified task adds one nacre layer to its public record, and only pearls with enough layers can draw paid work from the shared lagoon. A zephyr newcomer arrives with no layers and must finish small peer-checked jobs before its bids are accepted. Cloning an identity means regrowing every layer from scratch, so a sybil farmer pays the full cost of real work per fake agent while earning only newcomer rates, and the attack loses money by construction.
